h: A Grown-Up Night Out With a Difference
p: Ninja parks aren't just for kids. A lot of adults book in for an evening session with friends or colleagues, and it makes a refreshing change from another night in the pub. There's a bit of healthy competition, plenty of laughter and a decent workout thrown in, and you can still go for a drink afterwards if you want.

If you're going as a group, it helps to agree in advance that nobody has to be good at it. Somebody will fall off the first obstacle, somebody will surprise everyone, and that's what makes it memorable. Do check the session times aimed at adults and older teens when you book.

Guildford's surrounding countryside is a big part of its appeal. The Surrey Hills start right on the edge of town, with Newlands Corner and St Martha's Hill both great for walks and views across the Weald. Guildford Cathedral, up on Stag Hill, is worth a look for its modern architecture and views over the town.
For a day out, RHS Garden Wisley is only a short drive up the A3, and Watts Gallery in Compton, an artists' village set in pretty countryside, makes for a calm, interesting afternoon.
